features: Supports 12MP/8MP/5MP/4MP/3MP/1080P PoE cameras; limited third-party compatibility
Network protocols also listed: TCP/IP, NTP, DHCP, PPPoE, DNS, DDNS, SNMP, SMTP, IPv6, IPv4
USB: front 1 x USB 2.0; rear 1 x USB 2.0, 1 x USB 3.0
Remote access via Guard Live app and Guard Station client
notes: Description says there are no built-in PoE ports (external PoE switch required); spec table lists 8 PoE ports. PoE port count left out.
Spec table and description give up to 10TB per HDD (2 x 10TB); key features give up to 24TB. Maximum capacity left out. Spec table adds that maximum HDD capacity varies with environment temperature.
Power consumption stated as 12 W or less without hard disk.
